[SWS_CM_10429] Identifying the right application error in a message with Mes-
sage Type set to
ERROR
(0x81)
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_SOMEIP_00008
⌈
If the Message Type is set to ERROR (0x81) then the corresponding
ApApplica-
tionError
shall be identified by de-serializing the Payload of the message according
to the error payload format described in [SWS_CM_10428].
⌋
